objective: Standard statement: for a gadget (n triangles glued at vertices; corners A, B, C each in one triangle, in roles a, b, c; inner vertices in at least two triangles; connected) and the standing wave w_theta = (-1)^a sin(theta E)/sin(theta) with e^(4 i theta) not 1, prove: (1) the flip parity n + (number of inner vertices with an odd number of base incidences) is odd for every gadget; (2) w_theta is exact iff the six corner sums with mixed corner sectors vanish and the remaining sum is nonzero, which for connected gadgets holds for all but finitely many theta once the mixed sums vanish identically; the cosine wave is exact under the same vanishing iff n is odd; (3) sufficient mechanisms: locking (every mixed assignment meets an odd-base inner vertex with sector sum 0, in particular frames of locking vertices) and sign-reversing involutions (for example twin triangles sharing two vertices in equal roles); (4) towers inherit exactness, and frames with arbitrary interiors give exact towers of every growth exponent. Nearest known result: SIGNED-GASKETS-20261029-001A and SIMPLEX-GASKETS-20261029-001A (the sector method on Sierpinski gaskets). Classification: to be decided.
status: Proved by SPACE-SELECTION-20261030-001A-P001 (V1): the standing wave is exact on a gadget iff six mixed corner sector sums vanish (flip parity is automatic, so the conjectured 'locking plus odd parity' criterion is refuted); locking and balanced cancellation suffice but algebraic cancellations occur from six triangles; exact gadgets compose; tadpoles make growth exponents unbounded; at the knot angle a three-fold contact acts on phases as the not-all-equal knot. Erratum: Theorem 5 (interference bound) overlooks n = 1 and its proof uses the wrong hypergraph; corrected and shown sharp by SPACE-SELECTION-20261030-001C-P001.
title: The gadget criterion: when the wave reproduces itself on a gluing
